# 05-software

Firmware and ROS 2 chain: development environment, software safety requirements, architecture, safety analysis, unit design and verification, integration, validation on target, safety parameters, ML engineering, cybersecurity implementation.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §7–§8 and §10, IEC 61508-3 §7, IEC 62443-4-1 SI and SVV, MISRA C:2012, ISO/IEC TR 5469, ASPICE SWE.1–6, MLE.1–4.
